concept: Five distinct menswear outfits that make the adidas Samba OG feel intentional rather than interchangeable with every other Samba outfit online.
hook: 5 ways to wear Sambas without looking like everyone else.

audience.mixedGenderValue: The product is unisex, but this pilot remains menswear-first.

newProducts.name: Samba OG Shoes
newProducts.fitGuidance: Official page recommends ordering the usual size.

outfits.name: Clean Summer Uniform
outfits.when: Warm city days, casual lunches, and weekend plans.
outfits.why: Navy pleated shorts create clear contrast with the white-and-black shoe while the cream tee keeps the look quiet and intentional.

outfits.name: Relaxed Creative Office
outfits.when: Internships, creative offices, and casual client meetings.
outfits.why: The Oxford shirt and tailored trousers raise the formality while the low-profile Samba keeps the outfit contemporary rather than corporate.

outfits.name: Terrace Influence, Grown Up
outfits.when: Match days, coffee runs, and relaxed afternoons.
outfits.why: A knit polo and straight denim reference the shoe's terrace history without relying on a retro costume or loud branding.

outfits.name: Minimal Evening
outfits.when: Casual dinners, gallery openings, and low-key dates.
outfits.why: A controlled black palette lets the gum sole provide warmth and keeps the familiar sneaker from reading as an afterthought.

outfits.name: Weekend City Utility
outfits.when: Travel days, errands, and long weekends in the city.
outfits.why: A light overshirt and technical trousers introduce utility and texture without turning the Samba into a generic jeans-and-tee uniform.
